title: iBT 2026 Paket 1 — Campus Operations & Environmental Science
theme: Complete the Words, campus notices, biochar soil trials, email & interview tasks.

passages.title: Daily Life Notice: Campus Makerspace Safety Upgrade
passages.body:
To: Engineering & Design Students
Subject: Laser Cutter Access Starting Monday, March 9

During spring break, technicians installed upgraded exhaust filters in Makerspace Room 104. Effective Monday, students may reserve 45-minute cutting slots online only after passing the updated ten-minute ventilation quiz. Previous semester badges will remain valid for 3D printers, but laser cutter access pauses automatically until the new quiz appears on your student ID profile. Drop-in orientation runs Tuesday and Thursday at 1:00 PM.

passages.title: Biochar Amendments in Sandy Agricultural Soils
passages.body: Farmers cultivating sandy coastal plains face rapid nutrient leaching whenever heavy rain flushes nitrogen past shallow crop roots. Agronomists have increasingly tested biochar—charcoal produced by heating crop husks in low-oxygen kilns—as a porous soil amendment. Under scanning electron microscopes, biochar granules exhibit honeycomb micro-channels that hold both moisture and positively charged ammonium ions. In three-year field trials, plots blended with five percent biochar retained twenty-eight percent more plant-available water during dry spells without altering soil acidity dramatically.

assets.caption: W: Excuse me, isn't the campus bookstore still on the ground floor of Miller Hall?

M: Attention campus riders: because crews are repairing a water main near East Stadium, Green Route buses will skip the stadium loop until 5 PM today. Please board at Oak Commons instead. N: Which stop is temporarily suspended?

W: When agricultural husks burn in open air, almost everything turns to fine ash. By restricting oxygen inside a pyrolysis kiln, however, heat drives off volatile gases while locking carbon into a rigid porous sponge. N: What distinguishes low-oxygen kiln heating?
W: Please submit your revised field report before noon on Friday.

items.prompt: Complete the Word: 'Library staff will arch___ fragile 19th-century maps inside humidity-controlled vaults.' (Write the full verb matching 'arch___')
items.explanation: Kata kerja 'archive' melengkapi potongan 'arch___' agar sesuai konteks penyimpanan peta tua di brankas khusus.

items.prompt: Based on the Makerspace Notice, what must a student with last semester's badge do to use the laser cutter?
options: Pass the updated ten-minute ventilation quiz before booking a slot.
Re-take the full 3D printer orientation course.
Request a paper form from the engineering dean.
Wait until next autumn semester to reserve Room 104.
items.answer: Pass the updated ten-minute ventilation quiz before booking a slot.
acceptedAnswers: Pass the updated ten-minute ventilation quiz before booking a slot.
items.explanation: Pengumuman menjelaskan badge lama tetap berlaku untuk printer 3D, namun akses laser cutter tertahan sampai kuis ventilasi baru selesai.

items.prompt: In Passage 2 ('Biochar Amendments'), why does the author mention honeycomb micro-channels?
options: To explain the physical structure enabling biochar to retain water and nutrients
To criticize high costs of scanning electron microscopes
To show biochar dissolves sandy clay within three seasons
To argue kilns release excessive oxygen into coastal plains
items.answer: To explain the physical structure enabling biochar to retain water and nutrients
acceptedAnswers: To explain the physical structure enabling biochar to retain water and nutrients
items.explanation: Struktur pori mikro seperti sarang lebah menjelaskan mekanisme fisik daya ikat air dan ion amonium.

items.prompt: Listen and Choose a Response: Select the most natural reply to the speaker.
options: Actually, the bookstore moved next to the dining commons last week.
Yes, I read three chapters of economics yesterday.
No, I rarely carry heavy winter coats in July.
Thank you, the printer cartridge arrived on Tuesday.
items.answer: Actually, the bookstore moved next to the dining commons last week.
acceptedAnswers: Actually, the bookstore moved next to the dining commons last week.
items.explanation: Pembicara menanyakan arah ke toko buku kampus; balasan paling tepat memberi informasi lokasi terbaru toko buku.

items.prompt: Listen to the campus shuttle announcement. Which stop is temporarily suspended today?
options: The East Stadium loop stop until 5 PM
The Main Library gate all weekend
The Science Quad terminal next Monday
All evening routes after 9 PM
items.answer: The East Stadium loop stop until 5 PM
acceptedAnswers: The East Stadium loop stop until 5 PM
items.explanation: Pengumuman menyebut perhentian East Stadium ditutup hingga pukul 17.00 akibat perbaikan pipa air.

items.prompt: Listen to the short environmental science talk. What key advantage of biochar kilns is emphasized?
options: Heating husks without abundant oxygen preserves porous carbon structures instead of turning biomass purely into ash.
Open bonfires produce stronger soil granules than sealed kilns.
Biochar eliminates the need for rainfall across desert regions.
Crop husks must be soaked in seawater before heating.
items.answer: Heating husks without abundant oxygen preserves porous carbon structures instead of turning biomass purely into ash.
acceptedAnswers: Heating husks without abundant oxygen preserves porous carbon structures instead of turning biomass purely into ash.
items.explanation: Pembicara mengontraskan pirolisis rendah oksigen (mempertahankan pori karbon) dengan pembakaran terbuka yang menyisakan abu.

items.prompt: Build a grammatical question from the word tiles: 'Could you tell me ___?'
options: where
the
chemistry
tutoring
center
moved
items.explanation: Embedded question sesudah 'Could you tell me' mengikuti pola Subjek + Kata Kerja ('where the chemistry tutoring center moved').

items.prompt: Write an Email (60–100 words): You missed Friday's mandatory lab safety orientation due to a documented clinic visit. Email your lab supervisor (Dr. Rivera) to apologize briefly, explain the situation, and request one alternative completion option before next week's lab.
items.explanation: Email iBT 2026 dinilai dari kejelasan tujuan, nada profesional, pemenuhan ketiga poin prompt, dan ketepatan tata bahasa.

items.prompt: Write for an Academic Discussion (100–140 words): Professor Kim asks: 'Should universities require all undergraduate students, regardless of major, to complete at least one environmental literacy course?' Maya argues yes because climate decisions affect every profession; Liam argues electives should remain flexible so technical majors graduate on time. State your view and engage their points.
items.explanation: Diskusi akademik menuntut posisi tegas, respons langsung ke poin Maya/Liam, alasan mendalam, dan contoh spesifik.

items.prompt: Listen and Repeat: Play the audio prompt once, then record yourself repeating the exact sentence clearly with natural phrasing.
items.answer: Please submit your revised field report before noon on Friday.
acceptedAnswers: Please submit your revised field report before noon on Friday.
items.explanation: Perhatikan kejelasan konsonan akhir ('submit', 'revised', 'report') dan jeda alami sebelum 'before noon'.
items.referenceText: Please submit your revised field report before noon on Friday.

items.prompt: Take an Interview (Question 1 · ~45s): 'When learning a new technical skill, do you prefer following structured video demonstrations or experimenting directly with hands-on projects? Give one reason and an example.'
items.explanation: Pakai pola Direct Answer -> Reason -> Concrete Example; jaga tempo stabil tanpa jeda panjang.

items.prompt: Take an Interview (Question 2 · ~45s): 'Some student clubs restrict meetings to members in a single major, while others stay open to everyone. Which policy benefits campus life more, and why?'
items.explanation: Bandingkan kedua sisi secara singkat lalu tekankan satu manfaat utama dengan contoh kegiatan nyata.
